create_channel_option_gzip: create a gRPC channel option tuple that sets Gzip as the default compression algorithm
create_channel_option_deflate: create a gRPC channel option tuple that sets Deflate as the default compression algorithm
compression_algorithm_to_metadata_gzip: convert the Gzip compression algorithm into a gRPC metadata key-value tuple for request headers
augment_metadata_with_compression: augment existing gRPC metadata with a Gzip compression algorithm entry and return the merged tuple
review_compression_constants: review the NoCompression, Deflate, and Gzip compression algorithm constants exposed by the module
